verdict.rationale: Sentry Alerts explicitly support calling webhooks when issues are created/matched, giving AI-native users a way to subscribe to events, but the docs frame this as part of a general alerting/integrations system rather than a dedicated developer-facing webhook subscription API with payload schemas or event-type docs. missing for 10: dedicated webhook API/docs listing event types and payload formats, examples of AI agents consuming these webhooks, independent confirmation of reliability.
